info.title: Stellar Intel API
info.description:
Intent router and anchor rate aggregation API for the Stellar Intel platform.

## Public v1 surface

The stable, supported surface is namespaced under `/api/v1/...`; unversioned
routes are internal and may change without notice. Every v1 response follows
the hardening contract (see `lib/api/v1.ts`):

- **Error envelope** — errors return `{ "error": { "code", "message", "requestId" } }`.
- **Rate-limit headers** — `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`,
  `X-RateLimit-Reset` on every response; `Retry-After` on a `429`.
- **Idempotency** — send an `Idempotency-Key` header on mutating endpoints
  (e.g. `POST /api/v1/intent/offramp`); a retried request replays the original
  response (`Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of creating a second intent.

deadline.description: RFC 3339 datetime after which the intent must not execute

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the client may retry. Only present for code === "RATE_LIMITED"

sender.description: Stellar public key of the sender

status.description: Current health status: ok, fail, unknown (never checked), or stale (last check >24h ago)

degraded.description: True when anchor is auto-flagged degraded after repeated failures

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last nightly check, or null if never checked

lastError.description: Failure reason from the last check, or null on success

stale.description: True when the last probe is older than 24 hours

get.summary: Get live rates for a corridor
get.description: Returns live SEP-38 firm quotes (with SEP-24/SEP-6 fallback) for every integrated anchor serving the given corridor. Results are cached for 15 seconds.

post.description: Resolves an anchor route for the given asset corridor, builds an unsigned Stellar payment transaction, and returns a quote ID. Every response carries an `API-Version` header and `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining` / `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to safely retry: a repeated key within 24h replays the original response (flagged with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of re-executing the request. Only 200 and 400 responses are cached under a key; a 500 is never cached, so a retry with the same key will try again.

schema.description: Client-generated key. A repeated value within 24h replays the original response.

parameters.description: Client-generated key. A repeated value within 24h replays the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: Route resolved and unsigned transaction built

400.description: Validation error or no route found

get.description: Returns the anchor's current health status, last-probe timestamp, and score breakdown. Returns 'unknown' or 'stale' when probes haven't run recently — honest degradation rather than fabricated data.
Returns reputation data for a specific anchor. When a corridor query param is provided, returns per-corridor aggregates for 7/30/90-day windows. Without it, returns scorecards.
Returns bucketed outcome history for a specific anchor over a configurable time window.
Returns a ranked list of all anchors by composite reputation score. Optionally filter by corridor.

post.description: The single server-side write path for reputation outcome rows.
Submits a dispute against an intent outcome. The request must be Ed25519-signed by the original sender.
Proxies a SEP-6 withdrawal request to the specified anchor transfer server. Runs server-side to avoid CORS issues.

get.description: Returns the best anchor per corridor for a given USDC amount. Used for the landing page teaser. Cached for 10 minutes.
Returns the in-process metrics snapshot including intent counters, anchor latency, and publisher health.
Returns the current publisher health status including last run time, batch size, and staleness.

Triggers a batch of reputation outcome submissions to the Soroban oracle contract. Protected by CRON_SECRET. A mainnet tick is gated on 90 days of continuous probe coverage (#786); when the gate blocks, this still returns 200 with `submitted: 0` and a `gate` object explaining the refusal, because a withheld batch is the gate working rather than an incident.

200.description: Tick completed, or withheld by the publish gate

get.description: Simple health check / liveness probe for the MCP integration.
Lists all disputes. Requires admin authentication.

post.description: Accepts or rejects a dispute. Requires admin authentication.

get.description: Returns public 30-day corridor reputation scores. Supports conditional GET with ETags.

post.description: Additive GraphQL surface over the same data the REST API serves (see docs/GRAPHQL_API.md). REST remains the source of truth documented here; the GraphQL schema is published separately.
Internal, unversioned intent endpoint. Prefer `POST /api/v1/intent/offramp`, which carries the v1 hardening contract and idempotency guarantees.
The public v1 intent endpoint. Honours `Idempotency-Key`: a retried request replays the original response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` rather than creating a second intent.

get.description: Liveness and dependency status for the public v1 surface.
Progress toward statistically meaningful anchor scoring, combining settled outcomes with probe observations.
How much probe history has accumulated per anchor, and how that compares with the 90-day mainnet-readiness window.

get.summary: Anchor health export for the SDF Anchor Directory
get.description: Anchor health data in the shape SDF’s Anchor Directory consumes.

post.description: Cron-triggered. Probes every registered anchor across all four dimensions and persists the samples. Returns 500 when a sweep probes anchors but persists nothing. Protected by CRON_SECRET.

409.description: A refresh is already in progress

get.description: Cron-triggered reconciliation of pending outcome rows. Protected by CRON_SECRET.

post.description: Drops cached rate comparisons for one anchor or all of them. Admin only.

get.description: Admin only. See docs/WEBHOOKS.md for the delivery and signing contract.

post.description: Admin only. Returns the per-subscription HMAC signing secret once, at creation time.

get.description: Admin only. Deliveries that exhausted their retries and were dead-lettered (see docs/WEBHOOKS.md).
